workstream: P5 / AC1018-AC1021 TABLE row text-color and fill overrides

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

implementation.behavior: DRW_Table retains three row text colors, three fill-none flags and three row fill colors. CMC fields preserve method, flags, index, RGB presence/value, optional color/book names and source version via DRW_DwgCmColor. The strict DXF writer rejects selected table-level row styles and rejects retained row override data after its selection mask is cleared.
implementation.generatedControl: A from-scratch AC1021 vector exercises all nine title/header/data text/fill fields with literal ByLayer CMCs and boolean values, plus the already implemented alignment, text-style handle and height fields. It verifies typed values, exact body boundary and following sentinel.
implementation.outputControl: ASCII/Binary tests verify atomic refusal for selected unsupported row-style masks and orphaned row-style metadata, destination preservation and corrected same-adapter retry/readback.

limits: Generated codec consistency only; no physical producer or whole-drawing qualification.
Generated CMC case is ByLayer; other CMC color methods and native TABLE style/rendering remain unqualified.
Row style values remain output-ineligible pending a lossless DXF mapping.
The three border override masks remain unmodeled.
next: Establish a lossless DXF row-style representation before enabling output; then model and qualify each border override mask without weakening strict refusal.
